name: Asunder
tagline: Asunder is a graphical Audio CD ripper and encoder
blurb: Asunder is a graphical Audio CD ripper and encoder for Linux.
description:
Asunder is a graphical Audio CD ripper and encoder for Linux. You can use it to save tracks from an Audio CD
as
any of WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, Opus, WavPack, Musepack, AAC, and Monkey's Audio files.

• Can save audio tracks as WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC, Opus, Wavpack, Musepack, AAC, and Monkey's audio
files

• Uses CDDB to name and tag each track.

• Creates M3U playlists

• Can encode to multiple formats in one session

• Simultaneous rip and encode

• Does not require a specific desktop environment

Caveat Emptor: The ARM builds only had limited testing because ARM devices with CD players are rare.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
